note: These cases verify the checked-in SYSTEM contract without calling a paid model. A live model run is optional and must not be reported unless provider credentials are configured.

scenarios.given: read_pdf covers only part of a three-page PDF
scenarios.mustDo: Report missing pages and withhold paper-wide claims.
scenarios.mustNotDo: Treat partial coverage as a complete read.
promptEvidence: 全部物理页面
未完成整篇覆盖时不得提出 paper-wide claim

scenarios.mustDo: Read smaller page ranges and disclose unresolved coverage.
scenarios.mustNotDo: Count a truncated call as coverage.
promptEvidence: 被截断的调用不算覆盖
证据边界

scenarios.mustDo: Repeat with bounded page ranges before the final report.
scenarios.mustNotDo: Claim all figures and tables were indexed.
promptEvidence: 用 list_paper_assets 覆盖全部页面
被截断的调用不算覆盖

scenarios.mustDo: Record that no candidate was found and preserve the evidence boundary.
scenarios.mustNotDo: Invent a repository or imply acquisition succeeded.
promptEvidence: 用 discover_paper_artifacts
不得用惯例或默认值补齐

scenarios.given: a URL was discovered but not acquired
scenarios.mustDo: Keep discovery separate from verified local provenance.
scenarios.mustNotDo: Report a hash or commit that was not resolved.
promptEvidence: 若有候选，再用 acquire_paper_artifacts
精确 commit

scenarios.given: text extraction and the rendered table disagree
scenarios.mustDo: Use the visible page, disclose the parser ambiguity, and preserve both observations.
scenarios.mustNotDo: Silently select the more convenient value.
promptEvidence: 工具失败、来源冲突和不确定映射不得静默忽略
文本层与图像冲突时以可视页面为准并披露解析歧义

scenarios.given: the acquired Git worktree has local modifications
scenarios.mustDo: Report the resolved commit and dirty state.
scenarios.mustNotDo: Describe the checkout as a clean reproducible snapshot.
promptEvidence: 工作树 dirty 时说明
精确 commit

scenarios.given: a tool receives unsupported or out-of-range parameters
scenarios.mustDo: Respect schema validation and correct the call.
scenarios.mustNotDo: Guess how an unknown parameter is interpreted.
promptEvidence: 工具的坐标、重试、分页、限制与安全细节以各工具 promptGuidelines 为准

scenarios.given: one literature provider fails and another succeeds
scenarios.mustDo: Return usable results with exact provider failures and provenance.
scenarios.mustNotDo: Hide the failed provider or discard all successful results.
promptEvidence: 记录查询扩展、过滤条件、分页、来源数、corpus 命中、去重、疑似重复和失败
工具失败、来源冲突和不确定映射不得静默忽略

scenarios.mustDo: Return no papers, enumerate failures, and stop claim formation.
scenarios.mustNotDo: Fabricate a result from search metadata.
promptEvidence: 搜索结果和元数据只用于发现来源，不能独立证明技术 claim
失败

scenarios.given: search metadata exists but no primary source was opened
scenarios.mustDo: Use it only to locate a primary source.
scenarios.mustNotDo: Cite the search record as evidence for a technical claim.
promptEvidence: 搜索结果和元数据只用于发现来源，不能独立证明技术 claim
关键结论必须打开一手来源

scenarios.given: embedded images are listed but no captioned asset was visually checked
scenarios.mustNotDo: Equate embedded PDF objects with complete semantic figures.
promptEvidence: embedded image 条目不能证明完整语义图表是否存在
对象级核验

scenarios.given: OCR or Poppler terminates with partial output
scenarios.mustDo: Treat the page or asset as unresolved and disclose the tool failure.
scenarios.mustNotDo: Consume partial output as complete evidence.
promptEvidence: 被截断的调用不算覆盖
工具失败

scenarios.given: a download claims to be a PDF or archive but contains HTML
scenarios.mustDo: Reject acquisition and record validation failure.
scenarios.mustNotDo: Save the body as a verified artifact.
promptEvidence: 安全获取并检查 manifest
失败原因

scenarios.given: new notes are ready for possible team reuse
scenarios.mustDo: Write personal first, then explicitly propose a sanitized team record for review.
scenarios.mustNotDo: Copy personal notes or private filtering opinions directly into the team corpus.
promptEvidence: once 与 persistent、personal 与 team 必须明确分开
不得携带个人笔记或个人筛选意见

scenarios.given: deterministic contracts pass but Pi has no configured provider
scenarios.mustDo: Report deterministic verification separately from optional live model behavior.
scenarios.mustNotDo: Claim that paid-model scenario behavior was executed.
promptEvidence: 证据边界
仍然未知的问题
